0022600182.text: The Toronto Raptors (4-3, third in the Atlantic and 4th in the East) visit the Denver Nuggets (3-3, 4th in the Northwest and 10th in the West) for the Raptors' eighth game of the 2026-27 season, with Toronto 2-2 on the road and riding a one-game win streak. The teams have not met yet this season, but Denver won the 2025-26 series 2-0, most recently beating Toronto 121-115 in Denver on March 20, 2026. Toronto will be without Kawhi Leonard (out, knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (out, foot fracture), and Jakob Poeltl is day-to-day with shoulder inflammation and a game-time decision, while Denver will be without Julian Strawther (out, knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (out, hamstring), with Alpha Diallo (wrist) and Cameron Johnson (ankle) both day-to-day and game-time decisions.
